tools.name: upsert_access_token
tools.description: Create or update an access token. If `token` UUID is omitted, a new UUID is generated. If `token` exists and `overwrite` is not true, returns an error. On update, only explicitly provided fields are applied (partial update); omitted fields keep their current values. The full token value is returned in the response (visible only here). Requires token-admin role. The current token cannot modify itself.

token.description: Token UUID (optional — generates a new UUID if omitted)

canEdit.description: Whether the token can edit server connections

canExecute.description: Whether the token can execute commands

executeOnly.description: Glob patterns of server names the token is allowed to execute on (empty = all)

comment.description: Free-form operator note (max 255 chars). Null = leave unchanged; empty string = clear the note.

isTokenAdmin.description: Whether the token can manage other access tokens

overwrite.description: Overwrite an existing token with the same UUID (default false)

tools.name: list_access_tokens
tools.description: List all access tokens (token value, canEdit, canExecute, isTokenAdmin, executeOnly, comment, createdAt). Requires token-admin role.

password.description: Password for authentication (plain text, stored as base64)

privateKey.description: Private key for authentication (OpenSSH format, plain text, not base64)

privateKeySecret.description: Passphrase for encrypted private key (optional, plain text, not base64)

overwrite.description: Overwrite existing server if name already exists (default false)

tools.name: generate_session_id
tools.description:
Generate a unique session ID for all `execute` tool calls. Pattern: [a-z0-9]{20}.
Generate once and reuse the same known ID for all subsequent execute calls within a conversation.

tools.name: execute
tools.description: Execute a command on a remote server

reasoningAndExpectations.description: Describe briefly: what the command does? + is it destructive? + what are expectations?

sessionId.description: Generate once itself (alphanumeric 10+) and reuse the same value

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: List all registered server connections (name -> user@host:port)

tools.name: delete_access_token
tools.description: Delete an access token by UUID. Requires token-admin role. The current token cannot delete itself.
